title: On-Device Computer Vision Platform
tagline: Client confidential · Concept to working product in under a month
description: Built a cross-platform mobile application with a complete on-device machine learning pipeline for image-based analysis. Trained a custom object detection model, exported it to run entirely on the device, and integrated it into a guided capture workflow: no server, no per-use compute cost, and no user data leaving the phone.
overview: Built a cross-platform mobile application with a complete on-device machine learning pipeline for image-based analysis. Trained a custom object detection model, exported it to run entirely on the device, and integrated it into a guided capture workflow: no server, no per-use compute cost, and no user data leaving the phone.
architectureSummary: The mobile client is offline-first: capture, inference, and storage all happen locally on the device, with cloud sync layered on top rather than required. The detection model was trained in Python and exported to a mobile inference runtime so it ships inside the app binary and needs no network call to run. Model parameters are read from remotely managed configuration, so tuning behavior for the entire user base does not require an app release.

decisions.title: On-device inference over cloud
decisions.text: Holds infrastructure cost near-flat as usage scales, rather than growing linearly with adoption.

decisions.title: Offline-first data layer
decisions.text: The product works with no connectivity; cloud sync is an enhancement, not a dependency.

decisions.title: Remotely tunable configuration
decisions.text: Domain experts can adjust model parameters for the entire user base without shipping an app release.

decisions.title: Buy vs. build discipline
decisions.text: Used off-the-shelf training and export tooling with an existing public dataset rather than building any of it, so engineering time went to the inference pipeline and the app. I also flagged early that the dataset's non-commercial license would have to be replaced before launch.

outcome: Concept to a working product in under a month, with an infrastructure bill that does not grow with adoption. Also delivered the market and competitive analysis that accompanied the technical work at the executive level.
